term: equal (the AFP mL=, Leibniz equality at a world)
definition: x mL= y ≡ ∀(λφ. (φ x m→ φ y)): at a world, every property x has there, y has there. Indiscernibility at one world, not identity of individuals (Lean `=`); the Monotheism result does not conclude that there is exactly one God-like individual.
